About Me

Student by day, builder by habit.

Bahawalpur-based and Rajanpur-born — studying, managing, teaching and building a student community, all at once.

I'm Yalmaz Khan — from Rajanpur, now living in Bahawalpur, where I study, work, teach and run a student community.

I'm in my 2nd semester of BS Computer Science at The Islamia University of Bahawalpur. Alongside my studies, I work as Manager at Adeeb Technology Lab, a software house, where I help keep projects and people moving.

I also provide computer network services — designing, installing and maintaining networks — and I teach HTML to my own students. For them I prepared a 100-mark HTML test paper, with a complete answer key.

As the owner and admin of IUBians, I publish daily news and information posts for IUB students — admissions, exams, scholarships, results and alerts — in a signature Royal Navy & Gold style.
